title: Mini Peanut Praline Chocolate Pies: Crust, Praline, and Namelaka

locations.name: ATK Test Kitchen (probable)
locations.basis: Transcript references to 'test kitchens props' and ATK ecosystem; no explicit shooting location provided

summary: Lan Lam guides viewers through a three-in-one holiday dessert: mini peanut praline chocolate pies with a paper-thin, buttery crust, a roast-praline layer, and a silky Namelaka chocolate cream. The episode emphasizes beginner-friendly technique: a crust made in a food processor with extra water for sufficient gluten development, a dough rolled to about 1/8 inch thickness and baked in muffin cups to form shells, a two-stage bake to keep the shells flat, and a caramel-praline component ground to a dust and mixed with peanut butter. The Namelaka is built from gelatin-softened milk and melted chocolate, cooled to room temperature, then thickened with cream and piped into the shells. The host also shares practical hacks (Saint Honor piping with a simple plastic bag), finish with flaky salt, and storage guidelines, illustrating how each component can be used separately in other desserts.
